scope: Local synthetic quota and capacity evidence; no remote D1 access or deployment

retentionPreference.fullEnabled: Atomically soft-remove one global oldest by occurredOn,createdAt,id and insert one new expense
retentionPreference.aboveLimitEnabled: RETENTION_CLEANUP_REQUIRED; manual cleanup, no bulk deletion
retentionPreference.unauthorizedOldest: RETENTION_TARGET_FORBIDDEN; never pick a later permitted expense

capacitySemantics.getProjection: ledgerUsage: workspaceId, projects/expenseRecords {used, limit, remaining}; remaining is max(0, limit-used)
capacitySemantics.getScope: Billing uses personal owner; /api/v1/me uses selected workspace owner
capacitySemantics.getAuthorization: Capacity is read in the same credential/owner/membership snapshot batch. Public pricing and revoked authentication do not disclose personal usage.
capacitySemantics.getCounterSource: Cumulative project usage row, owner-indexed COUNT fallback before initialization; expense records always exact active COUNT. GET never writes. Normal mutations atomically reconcile legacy cumulative expense counters using post-mutation active state.

storageProbe.method: 100 ordinary Shared pool creates per case, 200 total, current migrations, real handle_ledger_request and PlanLimitedD1, explicit category, Pro policy, disabled Jev. Compare SQLite dbstat allocated pages and payload for expense tables and all their indexes before and after. Close all connections.
storageProbe.usageCounter: One row per owner was already initialized by category creation; 100 creates grew its payload by 2 bytes and added no pages.
storageProbe.modelFallback: Disabled paid-plan Jev assistance fallback remains in durable audit/replay DTO and is included in these measurements.
limits: SQLite page estimates from simple synthetic creates are not actual Cloudflare storage invoices or production-size benchmarks.
Exclude subsequent edit/delete immutable audits, recurring rules/occurrences, account baseline, DO journal, Cloudflare infrastructure overhead, backups and WAL.
Activity is retired after 24 hours; its measured peak must not be multiplied by all permanent historical records.
Actual field lengths, UUID insertion fragmentation and 4096-byte page quantization change results.
Probe used existing Pro write allowances; the provisional Max capacity at sampling does not affect the 100-row storage cases. Final default Max is 100000.

Storage probe preceded optional oldest replacement. Active-slot limits do not bound physical storage: removed financial rows/replays and every edit/removal audit remain retained. Replacement adds a removal audit and activity, which are not included in the ordinary-create sample.

readAmplification.source: ProductMeteredD1.batch calls refresh after each successful write; _refresh_records performs all-product-table COUNT and global app_state kind counts.
readAmplification.caveat: Immutable audit and replay tables grow alongside expenses. Other owners' data also participates. These traversal estimates and reservation upper bounds are not native D1 rows_read measurements. Capacity storage cost alone does not establish request cost or latency. Active quota now adds owner-indexed COUNT reads for creates/transactions and capacity GET, scanning retained rows including tombstones; these additional scans are not included in the earlier first-fill refresh estimates.

focusedTests.command: python -m pytest tests/test_ledger_plan_limits.py tests/test_ledger_capacity_usage.py tests/test_cloudflare_billing_read.py tests/test_creem_catalog_projection.py tests/test_jev_plan_entitlements.py -q

retentionFocusedTests.command: python -m pytest tests/test_expense_retention.py tests/test_expense_retention_adversarial.py tests/test_ledger_plan_limits.py tests/test_ledger_capacity_usage.py tests/test_ledger_recurring.py tests/test_jev_preview_admission.py tests/test_recurring_meter_plan_limits.py tests/test_openapi_integration_contract.py -q
retentionFocusedTests.scope: Real local REST and SQLite transactions: all-plan cookie-only preference CAS, successful global-oldest replacement/ties, one commercial write, manual/project removal active accounting, legacy counter read/mutation reconciliation, recurring deletion replay, current authorization/ordinal races and atomic quota failure rollback

validation.maxBoundaryMethod: Synthetic cumulative project counter=99 plus 99999 physical shared expenses seeded by one finite local recursive CTE; real guarded PlanLimitedD1 mutations accept project100/expense100000, reject above-limit creates before native dispatch, and retain history and existing edits after downgrade. Active expense quota ignores legacy cumulative counters.
